body:
I'll start by understanding the repository structure, the SKILL.md rules, the source files available, and a style example.

I have the source facts mapped. Now I'll write chapter 11.

Wrote all five assigned chapters in `runtimes/podman_guide/`:

| File | Lines | Coverage |
|---|---:|---|
| `11-image-validation-and-signing.md` | 135 | `policy.json` scopes/trust types, verbatim sample excerpt, `image trust set/show --raw`, simple signing vs sigstore, `registries.d` storage, `--signature-policy`/`--tls-verify`, digest+signature+SBOM gate, explicit no-CVE-scanner limit |
| `12-manifests-and-artifacts.md` | 156 | manifest create/add/annotate/remove/push/inspect/rm, multi-arch + `--all`, `push --digestfile`, artifact add/exists/extract/inspect/ls/pull/push/rm, OCI artifact vs image, SBOM attachment, timestamp/registry caveats |
| `13-volumes-mounts-and-secrets.md` | 130 | volume lifecycle/drivers, bind/named/`:O`/tmpfs/image mounts, `:z`/`:Z`, `keep-id`/`U`/idmap, runtime `--secret` vs build `RUN --mount=type=secret`, export/import, prune safety |
| `14-networking.md` | 144 | Netavark-only backend, pasta/slirp4netns + 5.3 host communication, `network create` flags/drivers/plugins, connect/disconnect/reload/update/ls/inspect/prune/rm, all `--network` modes, ports/firewall, isolation, troubleshooting |
| `15-pods-and-namespaces.md` | 115 | full pod command surface, `--share`/`--infra`/`--net`/`--userns`, limits/labels/secrets, pod-owned ports, lifecycle and Quadlet `.pod` handoff |

Checks run: a local replica of `verify.py`'s citation-range, fence-verbatim/anchor/language/25-line, placeholder and chapter-shape rules — **0 errors across all five files** (chapters 115–156 lines, last two sections exactly `## Pitfalls` / `## Sources`). `verify.py` itself was not run, per assignment.
